Title: New customer taps an NFC tag and a session is created
Preconditions: Reader idle, no open group, tag tag_uat_01 enabled and registered
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_01. 2) Read the reader screen. 3) Open the staff floor view. 4) Inspect the session record.
Expected_result: Reader shows the waiting/new-group screen with the group id; a new group with one member exists; checkInTime equals the server time of the tap (+/-2 s); floor view lists the group

Title: Second tag within the join window joins the same group
Preconditions: Group active with 1 member, join window open (<=30 s since last tap)
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_02 within 30 s. 2) Read the reader. 3) Check the group in the floor view.
Expected_result: Reader shows 'joined' with the SAME group id; group now has 2 members; no second group is created; each member has its own checkInTime

Title: Late third member does not join silently
Preconditions: Group active with 2 members; 40 s elapsed since the last tap (window expired)
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_03. 2) Read the reader. 3) Check the floor view.
Expected_result: A NEW group is created for tag_uat_03; the existing group is unchanged; the screen makes it clear this is a new session (not a join)
Notes: Usability finding expected: customers may not understand why they were not added

Title: Re-tap by an already checked-in member does not create a second session
Preconditions: tag_uat_01 already in an active group
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_01 again. 2) Read the reader. 3) Count groups and sessions.
Expected_result: Reader shows the roster of the member's OWN group; group count unchanged; no new session created

Title: Duplicate scan inside the 2-second dedupe window returns the previous result
Preconditions: Fresh tag, reader and backend up
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_04. 2) Tap the same tag again within 2 s. 3) Inspect the response and the session count.
Expected_result: Second tap returns the identical result (same group id); exactly one session exists; dedupe entry expires and is forgotten after the window (a later tap is treated normally)

Title: Unregistered tag is rejected cleanly
Preconditions: Reader idle; card 'card_unregistered' has never been registered
Steps: 1) Tap the unregistered card. 2) Read the reader message. 3) Check the floor view and audit log.
Expected_result: Error TAG_NOT_FOUND; reader shows the fixed string 'Unknown card - see staff' without truncation; no session or group is created; the attempt is logged with result=failure

Title: Disabled tag is rejected and history is retained
Preconditions: tag_uat_05 disabled through POST /nfc-tags/:tagId/disable after having at least one past session
Steps: 1) Tap the disabled tag. 2) Read the reader. 3) Check the tag's historical sessions.
Expected_result: Error TAG_DISABLED; reader shows 'Card disabled - see staff'; no new session; past sessions still visible and intact; the rejection is audited

Title: Tag that is already in another active group gets its own roster
Preconditions: tag_uat_01 is in group A; a different open group B is active (open join window pointing at B)
Steps: 1) Tap tag_uat_01. 2) Read the reader. 3) Compare with group B.
Expected_result: Reader resolves to tag_uat_01's own group A (screen 'group'), not to B; nothing is added to B; no new session
Notes: No error is raised: api-contract treats TAG_ALREADY_IN_GROUP as a successful resolution

Title: Check-in is blocked when the consent notice has not been granted
Preconditions: Tag registered with consent record noticeVersion=2026-09-01, granted=false
Steps: 1) Tap the tag. 2) Read the reader. 3) Check the session and audit log.
Expected_result: Check-in is refused with a staff-facing message; no session is created; the refusal is logged; no personal data beyond the identifier is written
Notes: Also test the UI path: consent control unticked by default and stored with user id, notice version, purpose, date/time

Title: Only a peppered HMAC of the NFC UID is stored
Preconditions: One tag registered; access to the database and to the API response bodies
Steps: 1) Register a tag with a known raw UID. 2) Query the tags table. 3) Inspect POST /scans response and the audit log.
Expected_result: No raw UID and no bare unsalted hash appears in the database, the response, or any log; only the HMAC with the server pepper is stored; the stored value cannot be reversed from a leaked database alone
Notes: Covered by the automated test 'stores only a peppered HMAC of the UID, never a bare hash'

Title: Scan without a device key is rejected
Preconditions: Call POST /api/v1/scans directly without X-Device-Key
Steps: 1) Send the scan request with no device key. 2) Repeat with a wrong key. 3) Check for a session.
Expected_result: 401 for both requests; no session created; rejected attempts logged

Title: Network failure during a tap does not leave an orphan session
Preconditions: Backend stopped or wifi disconnected while the reader is on the idle screen
Steps: 1) Tap a valid tag. 2) Observe the reader screen. 3) Restore the network. 4) Tap again. 5) Check sessions and bills.
Expected_result: Reader shows a clear retry/failure state (no silent hang); after recovery exactly ONE session exists for the customer, priced from the moment the accepted tap was recorded; staff can identify and void any stray session
Notes: Record the reader's behaviour verbatim; if a session is created but the reader shows failure, log it as S1/S2

Title: Close button clears only the join window
Preconditions: Group active with an open join window
Steps: 1) Press close on the reader (POST /reader/dismiss). 2) Tap a new tag immediately. 3) Check the original group.
Expected_result: Join window is cleared and the reader returns to idle; the new tag starts a NEW group; the original group and its members are untouched; the dismiss action is not audited

Title: Five members join one group sequentially
Preconditions: Reader idle, 5 enabled tags
Steps: 1) Tap tags 1-5 in sequence, each within 30 s of the previous. 2) Check the group and the floor view.
Expected_result: One group with 5 members; per-member checkInTime strictly increasing; reader shows each new member as joined; total bill equals the sum of members' started minutes at 50 satang/min
Notes: Run as UAT scenario S2/S3 with real customers

Title: Floor view shows the new group and the scanning member within 3 s
Preconditions: Staff web app open on WSS /ws/admin, sorted by active groups
Steps: 1) Tap a tag. 2) Watch the floor view without refreshing. 3) Compare the highlighted member with the customer who actually tapped.
Test_data: one tag, one observer at the reader
Expected_result: Group appears within 3 s via group.updated; scan.activity highlights the correct member; no manual refresh needed; staff can identify the group before charging (note: no table number exists in the data model - see R8)

Title: Individual check-out closes one member and keeps the group active
Preconditions: Group with 3 members, all checked in >5 min
Steps: 1) Staff selects member 1. 2) Enter the amount shown by the system. 3) Confirm with customerConfirmed=true. 4) Re-read the group.
Expected_result: Member 1's session status = closed with checkOutTime; members 2 and 3 still active with unchanged checkInTime; group status still active; one receipt for member 1 only

Title: Whole-group check-out closes every member in one action
Preconditions: Group with 3 active members
Steps: 1) POST /groups/:groupId/check-out with the group amount and customerConfirmed=true. 2) Read the group. 3) Count receipts.
Expected_result: All three sessions closed with the same checkOutTime (+/-1 s); group status closed; receipts total equals the sum of member bills; staff channel receives session.closed per member

Title: Check-out is refused without explicit customer confirmation
Preconditions: Active session with a valid amount
Steps: 1) POST check-out with customerConfirmed omitted. 2) Repeat with customerConfirmed=false. 3) Check the session and receipts.
Expected_result: Both requests rejected with CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED (4xx); session still active; no receipt written; refusals logged; the staff UI never allows confirming a preselected checkbox
Notes: Covered by the automated test 'rejects checkout without explicit confirmation'

Title: Stale or incorrect amount is rejected and the correct figure returned
Preconditions: Active session whose true bill is 4250 satang
Steps: 1) POST check-out with amount=3000. 2) Read the response. 3) POST again with 4250.
Expected_result: First call rejected and the response carries the exact current figure (4250); nothing is closed; second call succeeds; the bill prices from the stored check-in time, never from the client
Notes: Covered by 'tells a client the exact figure when its confirmed amount is stale'

Title: Bill uses whole started minutes
Preconditions: Session started 10:00:00; checkout attempted 11:01:10
Steps: 1) Check out the session at 11:01:10. 2) Compare the amount with the expected value.
Expected_result: 3050 satang (61 x 50) is accepted and stored on the receipt; the staff UI shows 30.50 THB; no per-second drift

Title: Billing boundaries: exact minute vs one second over
Preconditions: Two sessions with controllable start times
Steps: 1) Check out session A at exactly 30:00 elapsed. 2) Check out session B at 30:01 elapsed.
Expected_result: A = 1500 satang (30 minutes); B = 1550 satang (31 started minutes); the difference is exactly one 50-satang step
Notes: Run both on the same build within minutes of each other

Title: A session cannot be checked out twice
Preconditions: Session already closed with a receipt
Steps: 1) POST check-out again for the same sessionId. 2) Check receipts and totals.
Expected_result: Second request rejected (already closed); no second receipt; the session's amount and checkOutTime are unchanged

Title: Group check-out after one member already left individually
Preconditions: Group of 3; member 1 already checked out and paid
Steps: 1) Check out the remaining group. 2) Sum all receipts. 3) Compare with the expected total.
Expected_result: Only members 2 and 3 close; the group total excludes member 1 (already billed); sum of all receipts equals the expected total; no double charge

Title: Reader displays the checkout result pushed over WSS
Preconditions: Reader showing the 'group' screen; authenticated reader socket
Steps: 1) Staff checkout a member. 2) Observe the reader without touching it.
Expected_result: Reader switches to the success screen for that member via WS push; the message arrives within a few seconds; the screen clears when dismissed/timed out
Notes: WS is only live while the group screen is shown - document what the customer sees if they walked away

Title: Polling fallback returns the outcome exactly once
Preconditions: Reader in polling mode (WS unavailable)
Steps: 1) Trigger a checkout. 2) Let the reader poll. 3) Continue polling after the result is received.
Expected_result: The outcome is returned once, then acknowledged and cleared; the customer never sees a repeated or stale success screen
Notes: Covered by 'serves the same outcome over the polling fallback, exactly once'

Title: WS drop during check-out does not lose the result
Preconditions: Reader on group screen; kill the WS connection just before checkout
Steps: 1) Drop the socket. 2) Staff checkout the member. 3) Let the reader reconnect and poll.
Expected_result: The billing result is committed and correct; the reader recovers the outcome after reconnect (WS or polling); no duplicate charge; the failure is visible to staff, not silent

Title: Receipt persists amount, staff, and timestamps
Preconditions: One completed check-out
Steps: 1) Open the receipt/session record. 2) Compare with the customer's expectation.
Expected_result: Receipt stores amountSatang, staffId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, group/member ids, and the confirmation record; values match what was displayed; the record is retrievable later

Title: Staff correction to a bill or time is audited with original and new value
Preconditions: Closed session with a receipt
Steps: 1) Staff adjust the amount or check-out time with a reason. 2) Open the audit log. 3) Open the original receipt.
Expected_result: Audit entry records staff account, original value, new value, reason, timestamp; the original record is preserved and the change is detectable; the customer-facing total reflects the correction consistently

Title: Check-out requires an authenticated staff account
Preconditions: No session / wrong password
Steps: 1) POST check-out with no credentials. 2) POST with a wrong password. 3) Check the session.
Expected_result: 401 for both; nothing closed; failed logins logged with account id, timestamp, result - never the password

Title: Floor view reflects the checkout within 3 s
Preconditions: Staff web app open, one active group
Steps: 1) Check out one member. 2) Watch the floor view. 3) Check out the last member.
Expected_result: The closed member disappears (or is marked closed) within 3 s; when the last member closes, the group leaves the active list; no manual refresh

Title: Immediate check-out charges one started minute
Preconditions: Tag checked in 10 s ago
Steps: 1) Check out immediately. 2) Read the amount.
Expected_result: Amount = 50 satang (1 started minute); never 0 and never negative; the receipt is consistent

Title: Audit log is append-only and survives operational resets
Preconditions: At least one check-in and one check-out recorded
Steps: 1) Attempt to update/delete an audit row. 2) Call the data reset endpoint. 3) Re-read the audit log and tag identities.
Expected_result: Update/delete attempts fail (no UPDATE/DELETE path); reset clears operational data but the audit log and tag identities remain complete and readable
Notes: Covered by 'resets operational data but keeps the audit log and the tag identities'

Title: Reading the audit log is itself logged
Preconditions: Staff/admin account with log access
Steps: 1) Query GET /api/v1/audit-logs. 2) Read the log again and search for that read.
Expected_result: The read is recorded with actor, time, and the records affected; a non-privileged account is refused

Title: Traffic log carries every required field and a retention setting
Preconditions: 10 check-ins and 10 check-outs recorded
Steps: 1) Export the log entries for those events. 2) Check each field. 3) Check the retention configuration.
Expected_result: Each entry has user/tag identifier (pseudonymous), action, result, endpoint, and an accurate consistent timestamp; retention is set to >=90 days; no private content is stored

Title: Busy-period throughput: 10 taps and 3 check-outs in 60 s
Preconditions: Reader idle, floor view open, one note-taker with a stopwatch
Steps: 1) Perform 10 taps across 4 tags within 60 s. 2) Perform 3 check-outs. 3) Record each response time.
Expected_result: Every response under 2 s; no duplicate sessions; bills correct; floor view keeps up; no error screens
Notes: Also note wifi latency measured on the day

Title: Double-click on group check-out produces one bill
Preconditions: Group with 3 active members
Steps: 1) Fire two group check-out requests concurrently with the same payload. 2) Count receipts. 3) Sum the amounts.
Expected_result: Exactly one checkout succeeds; the second is rejected as already closed; one receipt per member; total equals the group bill; row locks prevent double pricing

Title: No secrets or raw identifiers in any log
Preconditions: Logs and audit rows from the full phase
Steps: 1) Search all logs for the raw UID, passwords, device keys, and the DB password. 2) Inspect error payloads.
Expected_result: No match anywhere; errors return codes and messages without internal secrets or stack traces to the client

Title: Reader messages fit the display and are understood
Preconditions: Reader display 128x64 (or actual model)
Steps: 1) Trigger each screen: idle, waiting, joined, group, success, unknown card, disabled card, network error. 2) Ask a staff member to explain each one.
Expected_result: No text truncated or unreadable; each of the 8 states is explained correctly by the staff member and matches the error-code mapping in api-contract s5

Title: Origin and credential posture on the API
Preconditions: Browser demo origin allowed by config
Steps: 1) Call the API from the allowed demo origin. 2) Call it with credentials included from a foreign origin.
Expected_result: Allowed origin passes without credentials; foreign origin blocked; no wildcard CORS with credentials; no device or staff secret exposed to the browser

Title: Data reset clears operational state only
Preconditions: Sessions, receipts, and an open join window present
Steps: 1) Trigger reset. 2) Check groups, sessions, receipts, join window, dedupe cache, audit log, tags.
Expected_result: Operational data cleared in both stores; audit log and tag identities preserved; the reader returns to idle; no stale join window remains
Notes: Covered by the reset test - run it against both stores

Title: Timestamps are consistent between server, receipt, and UI
Preconditions: One check-in and one check-out
Steps: 1) Compare the tap time (stopwatch), the receipt checkInTime, and the floor view. 2) Confirm the timezone handling.
Expected_result: Stored timestamps are UTC/ISO on the wire and displayed in local time (+07:00) in the UI; no 7-hour offset error; bill minutes computed from the same clock
